name: Alquist Proft
title: Ravnican Master Sleuth
role: Detective investigating the Karlov Manor murders
summary: A detective whose work exposed mind control and Oba's hidden vengeance following Phyrexia's invasion.
biography: Proft investigated the Ravnican murders when initial evidence pointed toward the assassin Etrata.
He distinguished coerced acts from willing culpability and worked with Etrata, Kaya, and Kellan to test the evidence.
The investigation uncovered Oba's use of mind-controlling flowers and the grief beneath the Trostani leadership's public unity.

Proft's method depended on separating what could be observed from what suspects appeared to intend. In a city accustomed to guild intrigue and magical deception, a confession, an apparent assault, or a convenient accusation could not substitute for reconstructing the chain of action.

His cooperation with figures such as Etrata, Kaya, and Kellan brought together people with very different histories and reasons to distrust the authorities. The investigation shows why new arrivals through Omenpaths did not simply watch older Ravnican stories unfold; they could become participants in local institutions and their crises.

The discovery of Oba's involvement also reinterpreted the murders as consequences of the Phyrexian invasion and the pain it left behind. Proft's role was to uncover those connections without treating grievance as a reason to abandon evidence or excuse coercion.
